minigolf.name: Wind Gust
minigolf.desc: A gust of wind pushes the other player's next shot sideways.

minigolf.name: Magnet Hole
minigolf.desc: Your next shot: the hole pulls your ball in from much farther away.

minigolf.name: Ghost Ball
minigolf.desc: Your next shot floats through one wall or obstacle.

airhockey.name: Freeze
airhockey.desc: Freeze the other paddle for a moment.

airhockey.name: Giant Paddle
airhockey.desc: Your paddle grows huge for 5 seconds.

airhockey.name: Split Puck
airhockey.desc: The puck splits in two. Either one can score.
